CustomField.description: From the applied order form extractions (ContractLegalTermsApplier). Whether the model change itself requires customer notice and/or approval. Scenario (Legal, 2026-10-09): Rogo adds, replaces or upgrades a model through an existing provider (e.g. Fireworks, OpenAI) with provider, API, hosting, locations, data and purposes unchanged. An amendment answering None identified / Unresolved never overwrites; a different real answer flags legal review.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Does swapping or upgrading a model through an existing provider need customer notice or approval?
CustomField.label: Model Change Requirement
